svg.desc: Editable design boards for Sajda search, Swipe, Marketplace and foundations.

g.text: English-first product UI · import and edit freely in Figma
One coherent system, not a pile of tools.
Use clear product language and let verified data carry the weight.
Describe an idea, a word, or an exact domain
4 px rhythm · corners: 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 px · focus ring: 3 px action blue at 24%
140 ms control response · 220 ms surface response
No decorative motion by default. Respect reduced-motion preferences.
Keep the interface specific, calm and legible.
New concepts should reuse these primitives before introducing new visual language.
Search, verify and shortlist assets with clear evidence and purchasing context.
Describe an idea, a word, or an exact domain
Three ways in. One clear system.
Registry-checked names, one card at a time.
Fresh brandable directions when the first thought is not the last.
Words, constraints and useful context in one focused search.
A short, calm name with clear pronunciation and room to grow.
Compact, confident and easy to repeat.
Useful for a tool, studio or a new category.
Locked viewport · direct deck · settings only on demand
A clear home for domains worth holding.
Create a deliberate listing, prove control, receive interest, and keep the next move yours.
A concise, ownable name for a product or a serious new company.
Evidence and transfer are handled deliberately; status must never be implied.
Define the domain, price and selling context.
Add the requested DNS TXT record.
Choose the next step with clear buyer context.
A listing is a clear invitation, never a silent promise.
Discovery has to feel alive, but the evidence must remain visible and sober.
Theme search · exact checks · Swipe deck · contextual inspiration
Registry status · provider coverage · source and timestamp carried into the card
Save, compare, offer, create a sale page or use the public developer API
Use new concepts to make a state more legible — not merely louder.
• Preserve a single dominant action per moment.
• Separate verified facts from directions, estimates and illustrations.
• Use blue for action; green only for genuine confirmation.
• Make text survive translation before locking a component’s dimensions.
